ALREADY BROKEN       weak today, quantum is not the issue

  SHA-1  (2 occurrences)
    Chosen-prefix collisions demonstrated in 2020. Retire it.
    migrate to: SHA-256 or SHA-3
      gateway/jwt.go:6   "crypto/sha1"
      gateway/jwt.go:10   _ = sha1.New()

  MD5  (1 occurrence)
    Collisions are practical today. Quantum is not the problem here.
    migrate to: SHA-256 or SHA-3, or BLAKE2 for non-compliance use
      service/tokens.py:6   etag = hashlib.md5(b"body").hexdigest()
